4674.title: Full-turn timeline context defeats the source-work budget
4674.rootCauseOneLine: Turn-context expansion loads the full retained turn before response pagination; lifecycle appends miss the selection memo and repeat full projection.
4674.proposedFix: Design bounded incremental turn projection with rewrite/prune/context-clear invalidation while preserving current cursor semantics; not eligible for a simple automatic fix.
4674.caveats: Decode visits are not fresh JSON parse counts. Timings include test-only event freezing; reporter production stall statistics were not verified.
